summary.text: Jeanine Notter is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as a show host and fitness professional.

paragraphs.text: Jeanine Notter lives in New Hampshire and, according to Ballotpedia, has worked as a show host and fitness professional.

Ballotpedia says she was a founding member of Samuel Blumenfeld's Reading Foundation and volunteered as a board member of the New Hampshire Gold Star Mothers Memorial Association, the New Hampshire Federation of Republican Women, the Nashua Area Federated Republican Women and the Merrimack Republican Town Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Notter's House tenure as beginning in 2010, and she has represented Hillsborough 12 since the 2022 election.

She served on the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee in the 2011-2012 and 2013-2014 sessions and on the Science, Technology and Energy Committee in each session from 2015 through 2024.
